description_en: Queries the backup policy of a MongoDB instance
name: DescribeBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The instance type.

replicate: replica set instance

sharding: sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型。
replicate: 副本集实例
sharding: 分片集群实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region where the instance is located
parameters.name: src_region

BackupInterval.description_en:
The high-frequency backup frequency. Valid values:

-1: high-frequency backup is disabled.

15: every 15 minutes.

30: every 30 minutes.

60: every 1 hour.

120: every 2 hours.

180: every 3 hours.

240: every 4 hours.

360: every 6 hours.

480: every 8 hours.

720: every 12 hours
BackupInterval.description_zh:
高频备份频率，取值说明：

-1：不开启高频备份。
15：每15分钟。
30：每30分钟。
60：每1小时。
120：每2小时。
180：每3小时。
240：每4小时。
360：每6小时。
480：每8小时。
720：每12小时

BackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The backup retention period in days

BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion.description_en:
The backup retention policy.

0: All backup sets of the instance are immediately deleted when the instance is released

1: The instance is automatically backed up when it is released, and the backup set is retained for a long time

2: The instance is automatically backed up when it is released, and all backup sets of the cluster are retained for a long time

For more information, see [Long-term backup retention]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2779111.html）
BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion.description_zh:
备份保留策略。

0：实例释放时立即删除该实例的所有备份集
1：实例释放时会自动备份，长期保留该备份集
2：实例释放时会自动备份，并长期保留该集群的所有备份集

详细信息请参见：[长期保留备份]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2779111.html）

CrossBackupPeriod.description_en:
The geo-redundancy backup retention time.

Monday: Monday.

Tuesday: Tuesday.

Wednesday: Wednesday.

Thursday: Thursday.

Friday: Friday.

Saturday: Saturday.

Sunday: Sunday.

Required for geo-redundancy backup
CrossBackupPeriod.description_zh:
异地备份的保留时间。

Monday：周一。
Tuesday：周二。
Wednesday：周三。
Thursday：周四。
Friday：周五。
Saturday：周六。
Sunday：周日。

异地备份必填

CrossLogRetentionType.description_en:
The geo-redundancy log backup retention type.

delay: retained for a period of time

never: never expires
CrossLogRetentionType.description_zh:
异地日志备份保留类型。

delay: 保留一段时间
never: 不过期

CrossLogRetentionValue.description_en: The geo-redundancy log backup retention period
CrossLogRetentionValue.description_zh: 异地日志备份保留时长

CrossRetentionType.description_en:
The geo-redundancy backup retention type.

delay: retained for a period of time

never: never expires
CrossRetentionType.description_zh:
异地备份保留类型。

delay: 保留一段时间

never: 不过期

DestRegion.description_en: The region where the geo-redundancy backup is located

EnableBackupLog.description_en:
Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:

0: disabled (default).

1: enabled
EnableBackupLog.description_zh:
是否打开日志备份，取值说明：
0：关闭（默认值）。
1：打开

EnableCrossLogBackup.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-region log backup is enabled.

Required for geo-redundancy backup

1: enabled (must be 1 for sharded cluster instances)

0: disabled (must be 0 for replica set instances)
EnableCrossLogBackup.description_zh:
是否开启跨地域日志备份 。

异地备份必填
1： 打开  (分片集群必须为1)
0： 关闭 (副本实例必须为0)

HighFrequencyBackupRetention.description_en: The high-frequency backup retention period in days
HighFrequencyBackupRetention.description_zh: 高频备份保留天数，单位为天

LogBackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The log backup retention period in days. Valid values: 7 to 730
LogBackupRetentionPeriod.description_zh: 日志备份保留天数，取值范围：7~730

PreferredBackupPeriod.description_en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:

Monday: Monday.

Tuesday: Tuesday.

Wednesday: Wednesday.

Thursday: Thursday.

Friday: Friday.

Saturday: Saturday.

Sunday: Sunday
PreferredBackupPeriod.description_zh:
备份周期，取值说明：
Monday：星期一。
Tuesday：星期二。
Wednesday：星期三。
Thursday：星期四。
Friday：星期五。
Saturday：星期六。
Sunday：星期日

PreferredBackupTime.description_en: The backup time in the format of HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC time)

PreferredNextBackupTime.description_en: The next regular backup time in the format of yyyy-mm-ddthh:mmz (UTC time)
PreferredNextBackupTime.description_zh: 下次常规备份时间，格式为yyyy-mm-ddthh:mmz（utc时间）

PreserveOneEachHour.description_en:
Indicates whether sparse backup within an hour is enabled.

true: When the backup frequency is at the minute level, all snapshots within 1 hour from the current time are retained. For snapshots that are more than 1 hour but within 24 hours from the current time, only the first snapshot after each hour is retained.

false: Sparse backup within an hour is disabled: all snapshots within the high-frequency backup retention period are retained
PreserveOneEachHour.description_zh:
是否开启小时内稀疏备份。

true：当备份频率为分钟级时，距离当前时间1小时内的快照全部保留。距离当前时间超过1小时且在24小时内的快照，仅保留整点后的第一个快照。

false：关闭小时内稀疏备份：高频备份保留天数内的快照全部保留

SnapshotBackupType.description_en:
The snapshot backup type. Valid values:

Flash: second-level backup.

Standard: regular backup (default)
SnapshotBackupType.description_zh:
快照备份类型，取值说明：

Flash：秒级备份。
Standard：常规备份（默认值）

SrcRegion.description_en: The region where the source instance is located
